name: Ultrasound abdomen report
normal_text: The liver is normal in size and echotexture with no focal lesion. The gallbladder is thin-walled without calculi and the common bile duct is not dilated. The spleen is normal in size and homogeneous. Both kidneys, the pancreas and the aorta appear normal, with no free fluid.

normal_text: The urinary bladder is well distended with a smooth wall. The pelvic organs (uterus and ovaries, or prostate) are normal in size and echotexture with no mass. No free fluid in the pelvis.

name: Ultrasound kidneys and urinary tract report
normal_text: Both kidneys are normal in size with preserved corticomedullary differentiation. No calculi and no pelvicalyceal dilatation. The bladder is unremarkable.

name: Ultrasound neck report
normal_text: The thyroid gland is normal in size and echotexture with no nodules. No enlarged or morphologically abnormal cervical lymph nodes. The salivary glands appear normal.

name: Venous Doppler ultrasound of the legs report
normal_text: The common femoral, femoral and popliteal veins of both legs are fully compressible with normal phasic flow and augmentation. No intraluminal thrombus is seen.

name: Carotid Doppler ultrasound report
normal_text: The common, internal and external carotid arteries are patent on both sides with normal intima-media thickness and normal flow velocities. No plaque is seen. Both vertebral arteries show antegrade flow.

name: Liver elastography report
normal_text: Ten valid measurements obtained. Median liver stiffness is 5.0 kPa with an interquartile range under 30% of the median, within the normal range. Controlled attenuation parameter is within normal limits.

name: CT head report
normal_text: Non-contrast CT of the head. Grey-white matter differentiation is preserved. No intracranial haemorrhage, mass effect or midline shift. The ventricles and extra-axial spaces are normal for age.

name: CT chest report
normal_text: CT of the chest. The lungs are clear with no nodules, consolidation or interstitial change. The airways are patent. No mediastinal or hilar lymph node enlargement and no pleural or pericardial fluid.

name: CT pulmonary angiogram report
normal_text: Good opacification of the pulmonary arterial tree to subsegmental level with no filling defect. The right ventricle is not dilated. The lungs are clear and there is no pleural fluid.

name: CT abdomen and pelvis report
normal_text: Contrast-enhanced CT of the abdomen and pelvis in the portal venous phase. The liver, spleen, pancreas, adrenal glands and kidneys are normal. The bowel is of normal calibre with no wall thickening. No lymph node enlargement, free fluid or free gas.

name: Whole-body low-dose CT report
normal_text: Whole-body low-dose CT from vertex to knees. The axial and appendicular skeleton is of normal density with no lytic or destructive lesion. No extramedullary soft tissue mass. Other organs in the field of view are unremarkable.

name: CT kidneys, ureters and bladder report
normal_text: Non-contrast CT of the urinary tract. No urinary tract calculi. No hydronephrosis or hydroureter and no perinephric stranding. The bladder is unremarkable.

name: CT neck report
normal_text: Contrast-enhanced CT of the neck. The pharynx, larynx, thyroid and salivary glands are normal. No enlarged cervical lymph nodes and no collection. The airway is patent.

name: MRI brain report

name: MRI spine report

name: MRI muscles report

name: MRCP report

name: MRI pituitary report

name: Echocardiogram report
